stepfather = a man married to your mother but not your father
sibling = a brother or sister
elder brother = a brother who is older than you
younger sister = a sister who is younger than you
twin sister = a sister born at the same time as you
grandparents = the parents of your mother or father
grandmother = the mother of your mother or father
grandfather = the father of your mother or father
grandchild = the child of your son or daughter
aunt = the sister of your parent, or your uncle's wife
uncle = the brother of your parent, or your aunt's husband
husband = the man a woman is married to
wife = the woman a man is married to
single = not married
engaged = having promised to get married
wedding = the ceremony and party when two people marry
honeymoon = a holiday just after a wedding
only child = a person with no brothers or sisters
nuclear family = parents and their children living together
single parent = a mother or father bringing up a child without a partner
